subject: Public Comments Form
comment:
The City of Saint George should be able to provide benefits to all FULL-time & part-time employees. Instead of hiring everybody at part-time, they need more full-time positions.

The city of St George police need to start citing drivers that are at fault in rear-end collisions. I was the victim of a rear-end collision and the driver at fault never got cited. This helps victims to be compensated easier from insurance companies and to not be given any grief.
